cases.purpose: Declared direction limit witness: the ar package is morphology-only and declares no sentence translation directions, so ar>en (a well-formed Arabic sentence, The girl sees the dog) must fail before any data loading with PLUGIN_DIRECTION_UNAVAILABLE and null text/meaning.

review.source: Independent expectation authored 2026-10-17 before any engine run (ar declares directions: [] so ar>en is refused at the direction gate regardless of valid Arabic input), corroborated by the manual CLI evidence in issue #297; reviewed and approved 2026-10-18; observed matching at main@caffbd52b5951cccc06708d055574d68486d1a62.
